topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: The tree is gone. A stump marks the spot where it stood, a silent testament to the passage of time. I remember those hands, small and eager, gripping the spade with determination. The sapling, a fragile promise, now replaced by a void. The space feels cold, unfamiliar. What remains is a patch of earth and memories, swirling around a silent scar in the landscape. The sky looms overhead, indifferent, as if the world itself has turned its back on what was once a living connection to the past.
